info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Plans-v2-spec
info.description: The List Streaming Subscriptions Plans API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of available streaming subscription plans. This endpoint is essential for developers looking to integrate subscription options into their applications, providing details such as pricing and plan features. Typical consumers include service providers and application developers aiming to enhance user experience by offering tailored subscription choices. Access to this information facilitates informed decision-making for clients and users interested in streaming services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of available subscription plans. It provides detailed information about each plan, enabling users to make informed decisions regarding their subscriptions.

requestBody.description: Contains the parameters necessary to fetch the subscription plans available to the user.
